summary.intent: Land a batch of Caliper fixes and features (Chakra NonNullable display, weekly harness fixes, terminal React builtins, module augmentation, Pick/keyof/union) as independently reviewed branches and PRs, after first repairing a CI failure on PR #271.
summary.outcome: Fixed the CI compile failure on #271 (commit 5634796a, all checks green except Entire Gates which needs user trail approval). A 10-agent workflow produced pushed, reviewed branches for chakra, harness and builtins; a second workflow is running to update the five branches, fix review findings, and then open stacked PRs.

repo: CI runs `cargo nextest run --workspace --exclude caliper-docgen-napi --locked`; running only a subset of crates (core, semantic, tsc-client) misses compile errors in the CLI crate's unit tests.
Adding a field to `InheritedLayer` requires updating struct literals in the CLI crate, not just core.
Standard pre-push checks are `just lint doc-check typos`, `just bench` (compare against origin/main), and cargo machete.

Branch stacking: chakra-nonnullable, terminal-react-builtins and react-module-augmentation target main; weekly-harness targets feat/collapsed-layer-members (#271); pick-keyof-union targets feat/terminal-react-builtins. Merge bottom-up and retarget child PRs to main once the parent merges.
PRs are opened through a shim, and commits are signed (verify signature shows G).
Chakra: 23 style props kept an unreduced NonNullable<Property.X<...> | undefined> from csstype's Fallback<T>; displayed_arg in resolver/named.rs only folded all-literal results.
AriaAttributes and RefAttributes<T> are now read from React's own interface via html::builtin_attributes (step 2.4 in resolver/chain.rs); `key` is intentionally omitted by policy.
just bench shows occasional one-off outliers (e.g. 1.20x chakra time on a ~60ms workload) that do not repeat; rerun before treating them as regressions.

On Linux a child's ru_maxrss can start at the parent's high-water mark, so weekly.py's large RDT JSON inflated every child's RSS; fixed by measuring via a forked helper (corpora.py measure) using wait4 usage. Only verified on macOS.

code.finding: InheritedLayer literal missing the new `members` field; broke CLI crate compilation in CI.
Second InheritedLayer literal missing `members`; fixed with `members: vec![]`.
displayed_arg only folded literal-only NonNullable results; fix adds without_nullish and can_hold_nullish to drop null/undefined when no remaining member alias can hold them.

workflow: Run the full CI-equivalent workspace test command before pushing rather than a subset of crates.
When a workflow's inline result is truncated, read the full output file or the per-agent journal.jsonl rather than assuming results are empty.
Independent per-branch review by separate agents surfaced verified findings that were then fixed in a follow-up workflow.

friction: Pushed a fix that only ran a subset of tests, causing a CI compile failure on the Test/Rust and Coverage jobs.
Workflow inline result was truncated (about 24k chars), requiring helper scripts to parse the output file.
Entire Gates check on #271 requires manual user trail approval and cannot be cleared by the agent.
The Linux RSS fix could not be verified locally (macOS only) and mantine, chakra and spectrum corpora were unavailable for tuning the harness exclusion rules.
open_items: Wait for the second workflow (wym91t1vu) to finish, then check each branch's result and open stacked PRs via the shim.
User must approve the Entire Gates trail on #271.
Retarget child PRs to main as parents merge.
Check the new CI run on 5634796a was confirmed green (it was) and watch the first weekly CI run for RSS correctness and unexpected exclusions on other corpora.
First weekly run may trip the 2-point recall notice because the reference set changed.
Ref props from RefAttributes<Payload['ref']> in Mantine-style factories print as unevaluated indexed access (ButtonFactory["ref"]).
Chakra NonNullable fix has not been compared against the oracle or RDT; it is display-only.
The shadcn re-export pairing did not reproduce (0 paired); 55 unpaired items remain in the denominator.
